_meta_itemized.notes: Stephanie Larsen, County Assessor, 2020 POST-ELECTION - the sibling of 11862 (her Pre-Election filing, itemized in this same chunk). The filer submitted a BARE COVER: one page, no schedules attached, signed 12/2/2020. EVIDENCE ON THE PERIOD-vs-CUMULATIVE GRAIN QUESTION, from same-candidate cover-differencing: this cover states contributions $1,480.52 / expenditures $1,480.52 / balance $0.00 in the CURRENT REPORT column with Last Report and Cumulative Totals both EMPTY - digit for digit the same three figures as her Pre-Election cover (11862). Two readings are possible and the pair does not decide between them: either the filer treats the Current Report column as CAMPAIGN-TO-DATE and simply restated a finished campaign, or the campaign genuinely transacted nothing between the two filings and the period figures coincide with the cumulative because there was only ever one period. Either way the Larsen pair carries NO grain conflict - unlike the Stevens 2020 trio in this same chunk, where the Post-Election cover (12943) fills all three columns and the period/cumulative split is explicit - so nothing here is withheld; there is simply no ledger to withhold. Worth noting for the ruling: Summit's own form does not require schedules to be attached, and the county accepted and published this cover-only submission.
